item.title: This Week on The Analog Antiquarian
item.description: Opus 1: The Comedy of Errors In other news, I’m afraid there will be no article next week, as my wife and I do some much-needed springtime home-and-garden work. I’ll see you in two weeks with some piping-hot fresh content — dealing very directly with games this time, I promise.
